comment_regular: Verified Oblivion setter: the bool parameter sets or clears TESFormMembr.flags bit 0x800. TESObjectREFR_LinkModifiedForm propagates this bit through ExtraEnableStateParent and the enable-state activation routine clears it. CalcLowPathToPoint independently appends '-Disabled' when this bit is set. Fallout's mangled TESForm::SetDisabled directly writes the same 0x800 mask; this is a cross-check, not the basis of the Oblivion interpretation.
